name: THE MAP SELLER
note: Doc 07 #16. Sells maps to Mott's strike. Unknowingly employed by the Improvement Company. Genuinely believes in them. The saddest character in the game and he is played entirely for laughs.

barks.R_SWINDLED: Map, sir? Turn it round for you?
barks.R_RACCOON: Map! Dollar! Nothing about raccoons on it, I’ll be honest.
barks.R_SURVEYED: You’ve had a survey! Now you want a map.
barks.R_BORDERS_MOTT: Sir — sir — you’ve land on it. You’re on the map. You’re on the map.
barks.R_WON_DUEL: Map for the champion. Ninety cents.
barks.R_DEAD: …Do you want one for the road?

sprite.note: Ruling 20, and a derived idle rather than a breath. A one-pixel breath on a 132px figure in a 3700px street is invisible; this is a WEIGHT SHIFT -- the body sways 1.6 degrees about the hips while the feet stay put and the head counters, derived at portrait scale by tools/rig/ambient-idle.py where a degree is fourteen pixels of shoulder. Head travel comes out at about 3px against the breath’s 1. The dog does not sway, because he is asleep: his cycle is the ribcage.

migrationNote: ERRATA 54, x6. Was (250, 116) in the 320x144 play area. THE AMBIENT LAYER WAS NEVER MIGRATED: tools/migrate-play-area-x6.mjs is an ALLOWLIST -- "anything not on the list is left exactly as it was" -- and it measured "17 rooms, 140 rects". An ambient character is not a room, so nothing named these and nothing touched them. Every one of them stood in the sky, 13-15% down a 864-tall play area, for as long as errata 54 has been in force, and the game loaded and validated and drew them there.
placeNote: Clear of the small office’s steps. Was (3120, 658).
